name: logo and tagline end card with two CTA pills
looks: A small coloured play-button mark and the wordmark settle together above centre, with a short tagline fading in underneath in a mixed weight (plain then muted). Two rounded button placeholders sit side by side beneath, and the frame holds.
build: Mark and wordmark fade/scale in together (0.92 -> 1, power3.out); tagline fades/rises 4-6px after; the two CTA pills fade in last on a short stagger and the frame holds at least 1s.
sound: A soft confirm tone as the mark lands, the bed fading out under the hold.
prompt: Close on a small mark and wordmark settling together above centre, a short tagline fading in underneath, and two rounded call-to-action buttons fading in side by side beneath that; hold the finished card for at least a second.
